function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve data. This function is commonly used for API calls and web scraping. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The Date Nager API provides access holiday information for over 100 countries, including the ability to query for long weekends. It leverages ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to tailor the search to your specific region of interest. More information can be found in https://date.nager.at/Api

headers.description: Optional headers to send with the request as a dictionary of header values.

Content-Type.description: The media type of the resource being requested, typically 'application/json'.

Authorization.description: The credentials to authenticate a user agent with a server, typically formatted as 'Bearer {token}'.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time to wait for a response from the server, in seconds. A longer timeout may be necessary for slower network connections or overloaded servers. This is a float type value.

params.description: URL parameters to append to the URL. Sent as a dictionary of key-value pairs.

query.description: The query parameter for search or filtering.

page.description: The page number parameter for pagination. Used to retrieve a specific page of results.

auth.description: HTTP authentication credentials formatted as a tuple of strings (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem), if required for the request.

cookies.description: Cookies to send with the request as a dictionary of cookie names and values.

sessionid.description: Session identifier cookie, used to recognize client sessions on the server.

csrftoken.description: CSRF protection token cookie, used to prevent cross-site request forgery attacks.

proxies.description: Proxy settings as a dictionary, mapping protocol or protocol and hostname to the URL of the proxy.

http.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTP requests, including the port number.

https.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTPS requests, including the port number.

stream.description: Whether to stream the download of the response. If False, the response content will be immediately downloaded. Streaming is useful for handling large files or responses.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not. Set to False to skip certificate verification, which is not recommended unless you are sure of the server's identity.

message.content:
I’m not able to pull live movie‑listings directly, but I can point you to the best places to look and give you a quick rundown of the theaters that are within walking distance of Times Square. From there you can filter for films that run under 2 hours (120 minutes) and pick the one that fits your taste.

---

## 1. Theaters within walking distance of Times Square

| Theater | Address | Approx. Walk from Times Square |
|---------|---------|--------------------------------|
| **AMC Empire 25** | 234 W 42nd St, New York, NY 10036 | ~5 min |
| **Regal Cinemas Times Square** | 225 W 42nd St, New York, NY 10036 | ~5 min |
| **AMC Times Square 8** | 225 W 42nd St, New York, NY 10036 | ~5 min |
| **Regal 18 Times Square** | 225 W 42nd St, New York, NY 10036 | ~5 min |
| **AMC Times Square 8** | 225 W 42nd St, New York, NY 10036 | ~5 min |
| **Regal 18 Times Square** | 225 W 42nd St, New York, NY 10036 | ~5 min |

> *All of these are on or very close to 42nd Street, so you can hop out of the subway and walk straight to the theater.*

---

## 2. How to find a < 2‑hour movie

| Platform | Steps |
|----------|-------|
| **AMC website** | 1. Go to <https://www.amc.com/movies/empire-25> (or the specific theater). 2. Click “Showtimes.” 3. Use the “Duration” filter (if available) or look at the listed runtime next to each film. |
| **Regal website** | 1. Visit <https://www.regmovies.com/>. 2. Search for “Times Square” or the theater’s address. 3. Browse showtimes; runtimes are usually shown. |
| **Fandango** | 1. Open <https://www.fandango.com/>. 2. Enter “Times Square” or the theater name. 3. Filter by “Runtime” or “Duration” to show only films ≤ 120 min. |
| **Google Maps** | 1. Search “movie theaters near Times Square.” 2. Click on a theater, then “Showtimes.” 3. Many listings include runtime info. |
| **Movie ticket apps** (e.g., AMC App, Regal App) | 1. Open the app. 2. Select the theater. 3. Use the “Duration” filter or check the runtime next to each film. |

---

## 3. Quick list of popular films that are usually < 2 hours

*(These runtimes are approximate and can vary slightly by version.)*

| Film | Runtime |
|------|---------|
| **The Grand Budapest Hotel** | 99 min |
| **The Social Network** | 135 min (just over 2 hrs, but often shown in a 2‑hr slot) |
| **The Imitation Game** | 113 min |
| **Arrival** | 116 min |
| **Moonlight** | 111 min |
| **Lady Bird** | 94 min |
| **The Shape of Water** | 123 min (slightly over, but often shown in a 2‑hr slot) |
| **Parasite** | 132 min (again, often shown in a 2‑hr slot) |
| **Jojo Rabbit** | 108 min |
| **The Farewell** | 95 min |

> *If you’re looking for something that definitely stays under 2 hrs, stick with titles like “The Grand Budapest Hotel,” “Moonlight,” or “Lady Bird.”*

---

## 4. Suggested next steps

1. **Pick a theater** – AMC Empire 25 is the largest and usually has the most options.  
2. **Check the showtimes** – Use the AMC website or the AMC app.  
3. **Filter by runtime** – If the site doesn’t let you filter, just glance at the runtime next to each film.  
4. **Book early** – Times Square theaters can fill up fast, especially on weekends.  

---

### Quick example (AMC Empire 25)

| Time | Film | Runtime |
|------|------|---------|
| 12:30 pm | *The Grand Budapest Hotel* | 99 min |
| 3:00 pm | *Moonlight* | 111 min |
| 5:30 pm | *Lady Bird* | 94 min |
| 8:00 pm | *Arrival* | 116 min |

*(These are illustrative times; check the actual schedule for today.)*

---

Let me know if you’d like help with a specific theater’s website or if you want me to look up a particular film’s runtime. Happy watching!
